what_happened: Planning found the owed cascade collapses to a SINGLE insertion, not an iteration: taking the insertion site u to be the region start of a's own region (the greatest idle position <= a) shifts every earlier region start down by d together, so their mutual distances are preserved and only their distance to the raised pin grows. d := l discharges hpins exactly, with no doubling recurrence. cascadeDemand/cascadeDemand_le_cascadeBound stay as the sizing record and are NOT consumed.

The hn0 anchor obligation of exists_ladderPath_of_walk is eliminable rather than constructible: drift_extension_of_pins (RunLayer.lean) applied to the pin family of a walk already satisfying hpins yields a Drift register whose value at 0 is a witnessing n0, so an anchor-free lift lemma exists_ladderPath_of_walk_of_pins drops hn0 entirely. This removes the sign-case analysis the insertion's two-sided displacement would otherwise force.

state.json file_scope anticipates a new module LadderCascade.lean, but the parent's Phase 11.11 close recorded a reasoned judgment AGAINST that split (the insertion walk reads spliceObj/spliceCnt and the Cascade section's pin bookkeeping at every step). LadderAgree.lean has 13 lines of headroom under its in-source longFile 2900 and the owed work is ~500 lines. The plan honours the recorded judgment: extend in place, raise the baseline to 3400, and keep LadderCascade.lean as a declared contingency only.

Phase 1's plan step directs raising LadderAgree.lean's in-source 'set_option linter.style.longFile' from 2900 to 3400. Lean's longFile linter requires the baseline to equal the file's own round-up to the next hundred, not a forward-looking ceiling: at 2967 lines it emitted 'The current limit is 3400, but it is expected to be 3100', introducing a new build warning into a previously warning-free module. Set to 3100 instead and recorded that the baseline tracks the file across the cascade's phases rather than being set once to 3400. Build exit 0 either way; only the warning differs.

After Phase 1's edit, 'bash scripts/check-module-invariants.sh' exits 1 on 'INV 3 file(s) carry a stale generated inventory block' (RaySummary/README.md, FormalSystem/Metalogic/README.md, root README.md) because LadderAgree.lean's line count moved 2887 -> 2968. Regenerating those blocks is Phase 6's declared scope ('--emit-inventory'), and Phase 1's own verification criteria do not include this check, so the red state is planned and expected to persist across Phases 1-4. Three blocks roll, not the four the parent's Phase 11.11 measured; the plan calls fewer-than-four a narrower outcome rather than a deviation. NOT fixed here: doing so would be executing Phase 6's work inside a single-phase dispatch.

Both Phase 1 declarations compiled first try from the plan's own tactic prescriptions, with no search tool and no goal-state iteration needed. drift_extension_of_pins accepted the 'if pend .. = false and pend .. = true then some (c (v+1)) else none' pin family WITHOUT any DecidablePred instance beyond the 'classical' tactic already opened in the proof, so the plan's recorded risk on that point did not materialise. The hn0 discharge needed drift_lipschitz_two_sided in TWO-SIDED form (the register value at 0 sits on either side of v), confirming the plan's choice of the two-sided statement over a one-sided one.

The phase commit was REFUSED by git-commit-scoped.sh's pre-commit typst-sync gate: 'typst-sync-check.sh --counts-only' Check 2 found generated/status.typ stale (formalsystem-line-count committed=396240 live=396321, tests-line-count committed=25980 live=26000) because this phase's +83/-1 and +20 line edits moved the repo line totals. The drift is attributable to THIS commit, not to a foreign writer, so the hook's bypass carve-out did not apply and 'bash scripts/typst-sync-check.sh --fix' plus staging typst/generated/status.typ was the sanctioned remedy. The plan's Phase 1 'Files to modify' list does not name typst/generated/status.typ, so a third file changed; it is a mechanically generated line-count artifact, not a hand edit. Every later phase of this plan that touches a .lean file will hit the same gate -- the plan's per-phase file lists should be read as implying it. First commit attempt also reported the V8 partial-commit guard; nothing landed on that attempt and HEAD was unchanged before the retry.

exists_region_start_of_idle_past compiled first try from the plan's prescribed pipeline. The Nat.find route of the landed cntAt_le_nxtAt_succ_of_idle_past was reusable AS WRITTEN with no refactor: the only additions were Nat.find_le (for the p <= s clause, which the model lemma does not need) and a re-indexing of Nat.find_min from the distance j to the position t = a - j. No helper was factored out of the landed lemma, so its signature is untouched.

The classical scope was NOT consumed: #print axioms gives [propext, Quot.sound], with no Classical.choice. Nat.find's DecidablePred comes free from Bool equality on the pend predicate, so the regime extraction is choice-free -- a strictly cleaner profile than Phase 1's anchor-free lift, which does need Classical.choice via drift_extension_of_pins. The classical line is kept for verbatim fidelity to the model lemma.

Neither longFile baseline needed raising this phase: LadderAgree.lean is 3024 lines against its 3100 baseline (Phase 1 raised it) and KTypeSummaryAxiomTest.lean is 2255 against 2300. Both scoped builds are warning-free. Phase 1's handoff warned later phases must bump the baseline as they grow; this phase's 56 lines did not reach it.

All three middle-band exclusions were needed and all three worked as written: hmax kills u < x <= a, the pending span of a under hcl (cntAt_sub_of_pend) kills a < x < a + l, and the collapsed block [u-l,u] is excluded separately because its whole image is the idle u so a position there has an idle successor. The seam x+1 = a+l needed no separate argument: it fell inside the pending-span case. No case required a hypothesis outside the pinned Challenge signature, so no binder was added and the phase did not need to block.

hu1 (the insertion site opens a region) is NOT read by insRegionStart_trichotomy, so linter.unusedVariables fired. The pinned Challenge signature carries hu1 and plan-compliance Statement Fidelity forbids dropping it, so it is kept and the linter is silenced with a scoped 'set_option linter.unusedVariables false in' plus a comment naming the reason -- the same convention already used at LadderPin.lean:166-169, LadderChain.lean:402-405 and four other sites in this file family. hu1 is the hypothesis insPins_of_region_start consumes in the next phase.

Phase 3's own verification criteria say the certificate-freedom grep on LadderAgree.lean 'returns no match'. It returns 2 matches, both PRE-EXISTING prose-only docstring mentions (line 150 satThreshold/satPeriod naming a FALSE form on the certificate side, line 2597 prodPre_periodic named as not routed through). The count at HEAD before this phase is identically 2, so nothing regressed; the plan's criterion was written as 'no match' where the landed baseline is 'no new match'. Neither mention is a proof term and the import list is unchanged at AnchorLayer + CounterQuotient.

The proof came in at 48 lines of tactic script plus a 24-line docstring, inside the plan's 90-140 line Scope Hypothesis band (72 lines total). It compiled on the second standalone probe attempt; the only first-attempt failure was an unknown identifier le_or_lt, replaced by lt_or_ge with the two branches reordered. git diff --stat: LadderAgree.lean +93, KTypeSummaryAxiomTest.lean +33, two files as declared.

All nine trichotomy pairs of insPins_of_region_start closed with pinCompat_of_ladderPath plus omega on the FIRST standalone probe, exactly as the plan's task list predicted pair by pair; no pair needed d > l, so the plan's [BLOCKED] contingency was never reached. The three mirror pairs were reachable by applying pinCompat_of_ladderPath with its two region-start arguments swapped -- omega treats Int.natAbs symmetrically -- so nine cases cost six distinct arguments and no arithmetic was re-proved. The tight pair (raised u, displaced-down y-l) needs exactly the l-sized deficit the plan named, confirming d := l is tight rather than merely sufficient.

Both in-source longFile baselines had to be raised in the same phase: LadderAgree.lean 3200 -> 3400 and KTypeSummaryAxiomTest.lean 2300 -> 2400. Both are the plan's pre-authorized primary remedy. Worth recording that the linter does NOT want the next-hundred round-up on LadderAgree: at 3200 lines against a 3200 limit it demanded 3400, not 3300, so the Phase 3 handoff's expectation of a per-hundred creep is wrong and Phase 5 will likely need no further raise there.

Both Phase 5 existentials elaborated clean on the FIRST standalone-probe attempt (lake env lean, exit 0, zero errors) with no tactic search: the composition the plan's task list wrote out is literally what compiles. The 'hself' shape that worked is exactly the pinned path-local one, passed as 'hself u (by omega) hu0' into insObj_step's single self-loop slot; no generalisation over Q and no sign-case analysis was needed. The 'u < v' argument DID need both halves as written: 'v = u' is killed by the pending/idle collision and 'v < u' by cntAt_sub_of_pend g hg v placing the idle u inside v's own pending span, and neither half subsumes the other.

The plan's Phase 5 task list names 'push_neg' for the join's negation step. On this toolchain push_neg is DEPRECATED and emits a two-paragraph warning per use, which would have put two new warnings into a previously warning-free module. The repository's live convention is already 'push Not' (FormalSystem/Metalogic/Soundness.lean:967, Expressiveness/EFGames/CustomGame.lean:865 and others; zero push_neg uses in LadderAgree.lean). Used 'push Not' at both sites. Same tactic, non-deprecated surface -- not a decomposition change.

scripts/check-module-invariants.sh C16 FAILED on entry to this phase, on a finding PRE-EXISTING at HEAD and not introduced here: env_linter's 'unusedArguments' reports insRegionStart_trichotomy's hu1 binder. The lesson is that the scoped 'set_option linter.unusedVariables false in' Phase 3 added silences only the SOURCE-level linter; the ENVIRONMENT linter reports the same binder independently and is invisible to both the scoped build (exit 0, zero warnings) and the module build Phase 3/4 verified against. Repaired with the repository's documented non-destructive remedy rather than 'runLinter --update': an in-source '@[nolint unusedArguments]' attribute plus a paired entry in scripts/nolint-attribute-allowlist.txt (C26 now reports 13 paired attributes, all paired). Signature unchanged, so Statement Fidelity is intact. Any later phase that adds a deliberately-unread pinned binder needs BOTH suppressions, not one.

(1) The certificate-freedom grep is specified as returning 'no match' on LadderAgree.lean; it returns 2, both prose (line 150 naming satThreshold/satPeriod inside a refutation sentence, line 2799 naming prodPre_periodic) and both byte-identical to HEAD -- the real invariant, no certificate-layer proof term in either new closure, holds. (2) check-module-invariants.sh still exits 1 on INV: 3 stale generated inventory blocks (RaySummary/README.md, Metalogic/README.md, root README.md) whose line counts this phase's +157 lines moved. Rolling them is Phase 6's declared task and its declared file list, so they are left stale here rather than widening this phase's territory.
